class.name: NNSTAnyOfGuard
class.brief_description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any of the [member guards] are satisfied.
class.description: This guard returns [code]true[/code] if any of the [member guards] are satisfied. This is useful for creating guards that can be satisfied by multiple conditions. For example, if you have a guard that checks if a variable is equal to [code]1[/code] or [code]2[/code], you can use this guard to check if either condition is satisfied. An empty [member guards] array returns [code]true[/code]. Any [code]null[/code] entries in [member guards] are skipped; if [member guards] is non-empty and every entry is either [code]null[/code] or unsatisfied, this guard returns [code]false[/code]. It reports the bitwise OR of the trigger types of all non-null entries in [member guards] from [method NNSTGuard.get_supported_trigger_types].

method.name: is_satisfied
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member guards] is empty or any non-null entry in [member guards] is satisfied, and [code]false[/code] if [member guards] is non-empty and no entry is satisfied (skipping [code]null[/code] entries).

members.member: Guards of which at least one must be satisfied for this guard to return [code]true[/code] (evaluated in order, short-circuiting on the first match). [code]null[/code] entries are skipped; an empty array returns [code]true[/code], while a non-empty array with only [code]null[/code] or unsatisfied entries returns [code]false[/code].
